messages:
maya: Heads up — nightly SAST started failing for infra/sdlc at ~01:30 UTC with KMS decrypt errors. Anyone oncall?

ian: I can take a look. Do we know if a key rotation happened recently?

ops-rotation-bot: automated: rotated cryptoKey projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/sdlc-kr/cryptoKeys/scan-key at 2026-03-21T01:12:05Z by ops/rotation-runner

maya: That matches the window. Scanner logs show: `ERROR: KMS decrypt failed: permission denied` from serviceAccount:ci-scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com

sam: Ok — likely RBAC on the key lost the scanner binding during rotation. Quick triage: can someone pull the key IAM and audit log? Don't grant anything yet until we capture evidence.

audit-bot: log-entry: projects/redwood/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity - binding removal for member serviceAccount:ci-scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com at 2026-03-21T01:11:58Z

ian: Got the audit. Root cause looks like rotation job re-applied a narrower policy and omitted the scanner SA. I can push an emergency grant if we agree.

maya: We need scans green for release. Agree on temporary grant with TTL + documented approval. Sam — can you prepare the command?

sam: Quick fix (manual):
```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/sdlc-kr/cryptoKeys/scan-key \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci-scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
I'll run with an explicit expiry via our ephemeral-grant automation: `./tools/ephemeral-grant --member=ci-scanner --role=cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter --ttl=2h`

maya: Please attach the audit export and the rotation job run id when you grant.

sam: Grant applied via ephemeral tool (ttl 2h). GrantID: eg-20260321-001. Linking audit: https://console.cloud.google.com/logs/query;query=rotation-runner

ian: Retrying the SAST job now.

sec-bot: scan-ci/infra/sdlc build #4592 started by ci-scanner@redwood — triggered retry

maya: Build passed ✅. Scans completed for all affected PRs.

ian: Immediate mitigation done. Next steps:
- make rotation job include a reconciliation step to re-apply required serviceAccounts (ops)
- add a pre-scan preflight in CI to validate KMS decrypt (devex)
- add a signed runbook note and incident ticket (security)

sam: Filing follow-ups: TICKET-SEC-824: rotation job reconciliation + tests (assign: ops)

sam: TICKET-DEVEX-129: preflight KMS access check added to `ci/scan` (assign: devex)

maya: Also add an alert to SLO that flags repeated post-rotation scan failures — we want earlier detection.

ian: I'll draft a short postmortem and link the audit logs + GrantID.

maya: Thanks all. Closing here after postmortem and PRs linked.

ian: FYI — proposed PR snippet for rotation job reconciliation (pseudo):
```
# after rotate
required_members=("serviceAccount:ci-scanner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" "serviceAccount:scanner-agent@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com")
for m in "${required_members[@]}"; do
  gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding $KEY --member="$m" --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter || echo "failed to add $m"
done
```

maya: Great — please include unit tests for the reconciliation logic. We'll review tomorrow in the security sync.

sec-bot: audit-note: emergency ephemeral grant recorded (GrantID eg-20260321-001)
